register.description: Create a Cloudy account with your email.
register.passwordShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.

onboarding.title: Create your first team
onboarding.description: Everything in Cloudy belongs to a team. You can invite people once it exists.
onboarding.newDescription: A new team, with you as its owner.

invite.title: Team invitation
invite.description: You have been invited to join a team on Cloudy.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account to accept this invitation. You will come straight back here.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
invite.notPending: This invitation can no longer be accepted (status: {status}).

shell.devBanner: Cloudy is in development — you can add servers and run checks on them; deploys are not available yet.

feedback.capturesDropped: The API did not accept the screenshot and logs, so the report was filed without them.

overview.serversHint: Add a server you already have with a one-line install command, or create one on Proxmox.

servers.description: Servers this team manages through the Cloudy agent.
servers.emptyHint: Install the agent on a server you already have, or create one on Proxmox.
servers.name: Name

new.title: Add a server
new.description: Cloudy manages a server through a small agent that connects out to Cloudy — no inbound SSH needed.
new.byoHint: Any Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 or Debian 12/13 machine with internet access. You run one command on it.
new.proxmoxHint: A VM cloned from a cloud-init template, or an unprivileged LXC container.
new.notConfiguredTitle: Proxmox is not configured for this team
new.notConfiguredHint: Add a Proxmox credential (API URL, token, node and storage) before Cloudy can create machines.
new.notConfiguredViewer: Ask an owner or admin of this team to add a Proxmox credential.
new.nameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore. Unique in this team.

sizes.small: Small — 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk
sizes.medium: Medium — 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 20 GB disk
sizes.large: Large — 4 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 40 GB disk

new.installHint: As a user with sudo. It downloads the agent, checks its checksum, runs the enrolment checks and starts it.
new.installRoot: Already root (a container or a fresh LXC)?
new.expires: This command works once and expires {when}.
new.waiting: Waiting for the agent to enrol…
new.enrolledHint: {name} is connected. The enrolment checks are below.

detail.checksEmpty: The agent reports checks when it enrols.
detail.pendingHint: Run the install command on the server. The page updates by itself when the agent enrols.
detail.pendingExpired: There is no valid install command. Create a new one.
detail.provisioningHint: Cloudy is creating the machine and installing the agent. Follow the log below.
detail.deleteHintByo: Cloudy forgets {name} and its history; the agent on it can no longer connect. Nothing on the server itself is deleted.
detail.deleteHintProxmox: The Proxmox machine behind {name} is destroyed, then Cloudy forgets it.

ops.title: Operations
ops.description: Typed operations only. Each one is signed by Cloudy and checked by the agent before it runs.
ops.empty: No operations yet. Run one above.
ops.offlineHint: The server is offline: operations wait in the queue until its agent reconnects (for up to an hour).
ops.notEnrolled: Operations become available once the agent has enrolled.
ops.readOnly: Your role can view operations but not run them.
ops.logEmpty: Select an operation to see its log.
ops.logWaiting: Waiting for the agent to start…

credentials.description: Provider accounts Cloudy uses to create machines. Secrets are encrypted with the team key and never shown in lists.
credentials.readOnly: Only owners and admins can see and manage provider credentials.
credentials.addHint: Use an API token limited to a Cloudy pool — never root@pam.
credentials.emptyHint: Add a Proxmox credential to create servers on Proxmox.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.fingerprintHint: Proxmox uses a self-signed certificate; Cloudy trusts only this one.
credentials.validate: Check it against Proxmox before saving
credentials.validateHint: Cloudy calls the API URL above with this token. Leave off to save without contacting Proxmox.
credentials.revealHint: The reveal is written to the team's audit log with your name.
credentials.deleteHint: Servers created with “{name}” are kept, but Cloudy can no longer manage their machines.

members.description: Everyone in this team and what they can do.
members.removeHint: {email} will lose access to this team straight away.

invitations.description: Invite people by email. Each invitation is a one-time link.
invitations.inviteHint: Choose the role they will have when they join.
invitations.createdHint: Copy this link now — it is shown only once.
invitations.noEmailHint: Cloudy does not deliver email in local development. Send this link to the person yourself.
invitations.emptyHint: Invitations you create appear here until they are accepted, revoked or expire.
invitations.revokeHint: The link sent to {email} will stop working.

tokens.description: Tokens let AI agents and MCP clients act on this team.
tokens.endpointHint: Point your MCP client at this URL with a token as the bearer.
tokens.createHint: Grant only the scopes the client needs.
tokens.createdOnce: Copy it now — it is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
tokens.emptyHint: Create a token to connect an MCP client.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.revokeHint: Clients using “{name}” will be refused from now on.
tokens.expiryHint: The token stops working after this.

scopeHelp.read: See the team and its resources

audit.description: Every change made in this team, newest first.
audit.emptyHint: Changes to the team, members, invitations and tokens are recorded here.
audit.subject: Subject

settings.renameHint: The name everyone in the team sees.
settings.viewerNote: Only owners and admins can rename the team.

twofa.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app every time you sign in.
twofa.secretHint: Add it to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
twofa.otpauthHint: Or open this link on the device with your authenticator app.
twofa.disableHint: Enter a current code to turn two-factor off.

reports.title: My reports
reports.emptyHint: Problems you report with “Report a problem” appear here with their status.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.description: Platform-wide MCP tokens. They act across every team — keep them few and short-lived.
admin.forbidden: This area is for Cloudy platform administrators.
